title: Second silent object seen by three witnesses

tellings.quote: The The second object that came a few weeks later was was was different structure. Um completely silent observed by three witnesses. My My ranch security and surveyor along with my caretakers of the time.

plain: In 2016, a few weeks after a first strange object, a second object with a different shape was seen at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for odd reports, and it made no sound at all. The ranch's owner tells this, saying the witnesses were three of his staff: his ranch security man and surveyor, and his caretakers at the time. He presents it as one of the events behind his belief that something unusual is at the ranch.
